decisions.reason: The award-winning premium raisin stollen is a flagship seasonal product that strengthens both sales and brand reputation, so it should clearly remain in the range.
The rye mixed bread with seeds fits everyday demand for hearty and slightly health-oriented bread and now stands out more after other bread variants were removed.
The dark barley malt rye bread is the most niche and overlapping of the remaining bread launches, so streamlining the assortment in favor of stronger core lines is the more likely choice.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is a proven seasonal variation that complements the flagship stollen and supports the firm’s holiday and gift business.
